translation.legal.agreement.intro: This agreement applies when you register, sign in, and use accounts, top-ups, packages, API calls, and related services provided by {{siteName}}. By registering or continuing to use the service, you understand and accept this agreement.
translation.legal.agreement.sections.account.title: Account Registration and Security
translation.legal.agreement.sections.account.body: You should provide true, accurate, and complete registration information and keep your account, password, and API keys secure. You are responsible for losses caused by voluntary disclosure, sharing, or poor account management.
translation.legal.agreement.sections.service.title: Service Scope
translation.legal.agreement.sections.service.body: {{siteName}} provides model calls, usage statistics, key management, top-ups, packages, and related capabilities. Available features, models, prices, and limits are subject to the information displayed on the site.
translation.legal.agreement.sections.usage.title: Compliant Use
translation.legal.agreement.sections.usage.body: You may not use the service for illegal activities, infringement, system abuse, bypassing access limits, excessive API usage, or actions that violate upstream service rules. The site may restrict, suspend, or terminate services for abnormal or non-compliant use.
translation.legal.agreement.sections.billing.title: Fees and Quotas
translation.legal.agreement.sections.billing.body: Top-ups, subscriptions, package quotas, validity periods, refund conditions, and usage rules are subject to the order and account pages. The site may adjust future prices or availability due to model, exchange rate, supplier, or business changes.
translation.legal.agreement.sections.availability.bo: The site will make reasonable efforts to keep services stable, but does not guarantee permanent, uninterrupted, or error-free operation. Third-party models, networks, payment services, maintenance, or force majeure may affect availability.
translation.legal.agreement.sections.termination.bod: If you violate this agreement, applicable laws, or site rules, the site may restrict features, freeze quotas, suspend accounts, or terminate services. You may stop using the service, but remain responsible for fees and obligations incurred before stopping.
translation.legal.agreement.sections.changes.title: Agreement Changes
translation.legal.agreement.sections.changes.body: The site may update this agreement for business, compliance, or security reasons. Updated terms will be displayed on this page. Continued use of the service means you accept the updated terms.
translation.legal.privacy.intro: This policy explains how {{siteName}} collects, uses, stores, and protects information when you register and use the service. The site processes necessary information for account management, service delivery, billing, security, and support.
translation.legal.privacy.sections.collection.title: Information Collected
translation.legal.privacy.sections.collection.body: We may collect information needed to provide the service, including username, email, login state, account identifiers, top-up and subscription records, API key configuration, usage records, error logs, device data, and network information.
translation.legal.privacy.sections.use.title: How Information Is Used
translation.legal.privacy.sections.use.body: Information is used for sign-in, identity checks, quota calculation, billing, service notices, risk detection, troubleshooting, customer support, and service improvement. We do not use personal information for purposes unrelated to this service.
translation.legal.privacy.sections.storage.title: Retention
translation.legal.privacy.sections.storage.body: We retain information for as long as needed to provide the service and meet accounting, audit, security traceability, or legal compliance needs. After that, information will be deleted, anonymized, or access-limited as appropriate.
translation.legal.privacy.sections.sharing.title: Third-Party Processing
translation.legal.privacy.sections.sharing.body: To complete model calls, payment settlement, email notices, security checks, or infrastructure operations, necessary information may be processed by relevant service providers. We limit sharing where possible and avoid sending information unrelated to the service.
translation.legal.privacy.sections.security.title: Security
translation.legal.privacy.sections.security.body: The site uses reasonable measures such as access control, transport protection, key management, and log auditing to protect information. No internet service can guarantee absolute security, so you should also protect your password and API keys.
translation.legal.privacy.sections.rights.title: Your Rights
translation.legal.privacy.sections.rights.body: You can view or update some information in your account page. You may also contact the site operator to request access, correction, deletion, or account closure. For security, identity verification may be required first.
translation.legal.privacy.sections.cookies.title: Local Storage
translation.legal.privacy.sections.cookies.body: The site may use cookies, LocalStorage, or similar technologies to keep login state, language preferences, interface settings, and security check results so core features work properly and the experience can be improved.
translation.legal.privacy.sections.changes.title: Policy Updates
translation.legal.privacy.sections.changes.body: This policy may be updated as service features, compliance needs, or security practices change. Updated content will be shown on this page. Continued use of the service means you understand the updated policy.

translation.appMarket.title: Built-in AI Apps
translation.appMarket.subtitle: This page lists AI tools that accept your platform username and password. Apps automatically detect available providers and charge API usage to your account balance.
translation.appMarket.toonflowDescription: Turn novels, scripts, and ideas into animated short dramas with AI writing, storyboards, character generation, and video production.
translation.appMarket.canvasDescription: Create images, edit references, generate videos, manage prompts, arrange assets, and collaborate in one infinite canvas.
translation.appMarket.productPageDescription: Upload product images, analyze product details, generate structured high-conversion hero images and product pages, and edit modules directly.
translation.appMarket.librechatDescription: Connect multiple AI models with support for Agents, MCP, Artifacts, code interpreter, file chat, search, and multi-user authentication.
translation.appMarket.webnovelWriterTagline: AI web novel writing system for long-form serials
translation.appMarket.webnovelWriterDescription: A Claude Code-based writing assistant for long-form web novels. It helps authors initialize settings, plan volume outlines, draft chapters, review quality, preserve story memory, and check project status to reduce forgetting and hallucinations in long AI writing workflows.
translation.appMarket.moneyPrinterTurboTagline: AI short-video generator for ready-to-publish clips
translation.appMarket.moneyPrinterTurboDescription: An open-source AI video creation tool that turns topics or keywords into scripts, selects materials, adds subtitles and voiceover, and generates HD short videos ready for publishing.
translation.appMarket.openDesignDescription: Turn Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents into a design engine for web, desktop, and mobile prototypes, slides, images, and video, with sandboxed previews and HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 export.
translation.appMarket.prismTagline: One product image, a complete e-commerce visual suite
translation.appMarket.prismDescription: Upload one product image to generate hero images, detail-page assets, product scenes, model shots, and social covers. Leave a marketplace review if you run into issues; Prism will keep evolving.
translation.appMarket.moreComingDesc: When new AI apps go live, their entrance, source code, images, and usage notes will be shown here.
